scope.intent: Guide conceptual and product-aware review alongside deterministic regression checks.

globalPrinciples.description: Each change should preserve or improve user outcome, not only technical correctness.
All user-facing fields must persist, reload, and remain consistent across read/write paths.
reviewSignals: No silent data loss between UI and persistence

globalPrinciples.description: Behavior, messaging, and permissions must be predictable for end users and operators.
reviewSignals: No unexpected side effects in adjacent flows

critical: Data loss in a core flow
high: Persisted state diverges from UI state
Flow blocked without user recovery path
medium: Flow works but has UX friction
Missing regression coverage for impacted flow

user-onboarding.userGoal: Create and activate a new user with required profile and access defaults.
mustHold: Required fields are captured and persisted
conceptualReviewQuestions: Does onboarding produce a usable account without hidden follow-up steps?
If a new field is introduced, is backward compatibility defined?
Is the first-login experience coherent with stored data and permissions?
commonFailureModes: Field accepted in UI but not persisted
Partial profile creation with no recovery
Account active in UI but inactive in backend
minimumRegressionCoverage: Persistence check for new/edited onboarding fields

user-offboarding.userGoal: Remove or deactivate access safely while preserving required auditability.
mustHold: User-facing or operator-facing confirmation is explicit
conceptualReviewQuestions: Can offboarding leave residual access in any channel?
Are downstream dependencies informed or handled?
Is the operation reversible where policy requires it?
commonFailureModes: UI says offboarded but token/session remains valid
No clear evidence of who/when performed offboarding
minimumRegressionCoverage: Attempted access after offboarding is denied

profile-edit.userGoal: Allow users or operators to update profile data safely and predictably.
mustHold: Edited fields persist and reload consistently
conceptualReviewQuestions: Can the user understand what changed and what failed?
Are required vs optional fields still clear?
Does edit behavior remain consistent across views or clients?
commonFailureModes: Update appears saved but reverts on reload
Validation differs between frontend and backend

permission-change.userGoal: Apply role/permission updates with clear security boundaries.
mustHold: Permissions change only for intended principal
conceptualReviewQuestions: Does the new permission model match real business responsibility?
Is least privilege maintained after change?
Can operators verify effective permissions quickly?
commonFailureModes: Permission removal not enforced in runtime
UI role label mismatched with backend policy

openPolicyQuestions: Confirm product owner for policy approval
Define SLA for fixing high/critical review findings
